source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: الشهر الماضي، سكن جنبنا جار جديد.
sentences.en: Last month, a new neighbor moved in next to us.

sentences.ar: بالأول، ما كنا نعرف عنه إشي.
sentences.en: At first, we didn't know anything about him.

sentences.ar: إمي قالت لازم نرحب فيه متل ما بتعمل الناس.
sentences.en: My mom said we should welcome him like people do.

sentences.ar: طبخت صحن أكل وبعتتني أوديه عنده.
sentences.en: She cooked a plate of food and sent me to take it to him.

sentences.ar: دقيت الباب وقدمتله الصحن ورحبت فيه.
sentences.en: I knocked on the door, gave him the plate, and welcomed him.

sentences.ar: فرح كتير وقال إنه لسا جديد بالبلد.
sentences.en: He was very happy and said he was new to the town.

sentences.ar: بعد يومين، رد علينا بصحن حلويات.
sentences.en: After two days, he returned the gesture with a plate of sweets.

sentences.ar: من يومها، صار من أحسن جيراننا.
sentences.en: Since that day, he became one of our best neighbors.

sentences.ar: تعلمنا إنه ترحيب صغير بيفتح قلوب كبيرة.
sentences.en: We learned that a small welcome opens big hearts.
